text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Brewer Heineken's shares tumble and traders angry after first-half profit below forecasts and announcement that full year profit would fall (page 15).
- Deutsche Babcock unit Thomassen International puts plans for bourse launch on backburner again, after four previous attempts never came to fruition (pages 1 and 4).
- Belgian trade unions claim Dutch steel group Hoogovens and Belgian group Usines Gustave Boel in secret takeover talks (page 4).
- Dutch investors plan huge theme park close to Disneyland Europe near Paris (page 15).
- Economy Minister Hans Wijers stands by industry rules allowing big businesses to borrow via the government for special projects (page 15).
